# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

Be respectful, technical and evidence-focused. Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language and deliberate disruption are not acceptable.

When reviewing model behavior, criticize outputs, methods and claims rather than people. Reproducibility disagreements should be resolved with concrete commands, logs or artifacts whenever possible.

Repository maintainers may edit or remove content that violates these expectations.
